the model no longer forgets the last reading when the Mac sleeps (or locks): the reading after the wake counts the gap (90 s). Caught by B-model (8 hours asleep: the first reading after counts nothing)

column6: more than once a day: every further hour off the same day shows it again. Caught by C-day and C-model
the shown day isn't saved: a relaunch the same day shows it again. Caught by C-model (relaunch) and A-model (its day is saved)
a timed pause is not exempt: the reminder during the person's Pause for 2 hours. Caught by D-timed
setup unfinished is not exempt: the reminder before setup is done. Caught by D-setup
Start Recording calls startCapture directly instead of the menu's Start (requestStart): with a permission turned off it no longer opens setup's Permissions page. Caught by E-path
rel-019 final: Input Monitoring turned on after launch is not exempt: the reminder offers a Start that opens setup's Quit & Reopen. Caught by D-reopen
rel-019 final: a change that didn't save is not exempt: the reminder offers a Start that opens setup's Apps page. Caught by D-unsaved
rel-019 final: the 0.1.9 rc's 90 s cap: a timer App Nap throttles to 5 minutes counts 90 s of every 5 minutes (the hour stretches past 3). Caught by B-late, B-throttled and B-throttled-model
